descriptions.w3d_d31e_set_class_hook_801e7270: Registers a hook for a class index on an object, unless the slot is locked (state 1, or state 2 when the new state is 0): stores the hook at +52 and the state at +64, then visits the class's direct children (iterating the actor type list and skipping non-children) and applies the hook with state 0 to every child whose state is still 0. Names are inferred.
